items.html: Another reason is that ZA, even when he is a complete Partzuf of ten Sefirot after the correction, is very small compared to Aba or Ima, since the NHY of Tevuna become Mochin in ZA and clothe throughout his whole stature. And all the more so now, when he has only six small points and not the secret of a Partzuf, and these too are three included within three; for it is found that all the discernments of these six extremities of his are included together and stand in the lower half of Tifferet of Ima, which is her womb, the place of pregnancy. And in all the rest, he is not an interposition between Arich and them; therefore this is not called an interposition or a break in ZON between AA and AVI. And there is yet another reason: since many lights are also included there, even if ZA were to interpose completely and entirely between Arich and Aba and Ima, it would make no difference, because of the abundance of lights that are there.
